scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose why a file copy failed during build

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the missing file is from a project output directory
Noticed the Debug vs Release path discrepancy
Recognized that the referenced project may not be part of the solution
Suggested adding the project to the solution as a fix

scenarios.reasoning: Accurate, well-evidenced diagnosis reaching the correct root cause with an efficient tool path. Weakened by a terse final message lacking explicit fix recommendations and by partly validating the conclusion from the case directory name rather than binlog evidence alone.
